fusions.name: Wheeling Blade
fusions.desc: Throws the blade wheeling for 7 wind damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stooping Sweep
fusions.desc: Drops you onto a target up to 7 tiles away and cuts a full circle on landing, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gleaning Flock
fusions.desc: Calls a flock that follows you for 10 seconds, pecking an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Falling Faster
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
